definitions.explanation: A religion that recognizes and worships a single God. Christianity, Islam, and Judaism are the principal examples. The opposite of {多神教|たしんきょう} (polytheism).

examples.japanese: キリスト{教|きょう}は{一神教|いっしんきょう}だ。
{一神教|いっしんきょう}では、{唯一|ゆいいつ}の{神|かみ}を{信|しん}じる。
examples.english: In monotheism, people believe in a single God.

examples.japanese: {一神教|いっしんきょう}と{多神教|たしんきょう}では、{世界|せかい}の{見方|みかた}が{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Monotheism and polytheism differ greatly in how they view the world.

notes:
Composed of {一|いち} (one) + {神|かみ} (god) + {教|きょう} (teaching, religion).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一神教|いっしんきょう}の{神|かみ}: the God of monotheism
- {一神教|いっしんきょう}{的|てき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}: a monotheistic way of thinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多神教|たしんきょう}: polytheism — the direct antonym, worshipping many gods.
